source.text: חָ֭כְמוֹת בָּנְתָ֣ה בֵיתָ֑הּ חָצְבָ֖ה עַמּוּדֶ֣יהָ שִׁבְעָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Wisdom has built her house; she has hewn her pillars, seven.

en.L: Wisdom has built her house; \q she has hewn her pillars, seven [of them].
en.B: Wisdom has built a house for herself \q and shaped seven pillars for it.
en.R: Wisdom has a new house. \q She has made seven strong columns to hold it up.

fr.L: La sagesse a bâti sa maison ; \q elle a taillé ses colonnes, sept [colonnes].
fr.B: La sagesse s’est bâti une maison \q et a taillé pour elle sept colonnes.
fr.R: La sagesse a une maison neuve. \q Elle a fait sept solides colonnes pour la soutenir.

sw.L: Hekima amejenga nyumba yake; \q amechonga nguzo zake, saba.
sw.B: Hekima amejijengea nyumba \q na kuichongea nguzo saba.
sw.R: Hekima ana nyumba mpya. \q Ametengeneza nguzo saba imara za kuitegemeza.

es.L: La sabiduría ha edificado su casa; \q ha labrado sus columnas, siete.
es.B: La sabiduría se ha construido una casa \q y ha tallado siete columnas para ella.
es.R: La sabiduría tiene una casa nueva. \q Ha hecho siete columnas fuertes para sostenerla.

decisions.choice: Wisdom: the plural form of 1:20
decisions.reason: The same plural of fullness (hokmot) as in 1:20.

decisions.choice: seven pillars: a large, complete house
decisions.reason: Seven is the number of completeness. A house with seven pillars is a grand house, fit for a feast. Many meanings have been suggested; the text does not say.

source.text: טָבְחָ֣ה טִ֭בְחָהּ מָסְכָ֣ה יֵינָ֑הּ אַ֝֗ף עָֽרְכָ֥ה שֻׁלְחָנָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: She has slaughtered her slaughter; she has mixed her wine; also she has set her table.

en.L: She has slaughtered her meat; she has mixed her wine; \q she has also set her table.
en.B: She has slaughtered her animals for the feast, mixed her wine \q and set her table.
en.R: She has cooked meat, mixed wine and set the table for a big meal.

fr.L: Elle a abattu ses bêtes ; elle a mêlé son vin ; \q elle a aussi dressé sa table.
fr.B: Elle a abattu ses bêtes pour le festin, préparé son vin \q et dressé sa table.
fr.R: Elle a fait cuire de la viande, préparé le vin et mis la table pour un grand repas.

sw.L: Amechinja nyama yake; amechanganya divai yake; \q pia ameandaa meza yake.
sw.B: Amechinja wanyama wake kwa ajili ya karamu, amechanganya divai yake \q na kuandaa meza yake.
sw.R: Amepika nyama, amechanganya divai, na ameandaa meza kwa ajili ya karamu kubwa.

es.L: Ha degollado sus reses; ha mezclado su vino; \q también ha puesto su mesa.
es.B: Ha matado sus animales para el banquete, ha mezclado su vino \q y ha puesto la mesa.
es.R: Ha cocinado carne, ha mezclado vino y ha puesto la mesa para una gran comida.

decisions.choice: mixed her wine: with spices or water
decisions.reason: Wine was mixed with spices for a feast (Song of Songs 8:2) or with water. The feast is ready; only guests are needed.

decisions.choice: slaughtered her meat: set against the woman of 7:14
decisions.reason: The strange woman also had meat from her offerings (7:14). Two feasts are offered in this chapter.

source.text: שָֽׁלְחָ֣ה נַעֲרֹתֶ֣יהָ תִקְרָ֑א עַל־גַּ֝פֵּ֗י מְרֹ֣מֵי קָֽרֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: She has sent out her maidservants; she calls on [the] tops of [the] heights of [the] town:

en.L: She has sent out her young women; \q she calls from the highest points of the town:
en.B: She has sent her young women out with the invitation; \q she calls from the high places of the town:
en.R: She has sent her servant girls to invite people. \q She calls out from the highest places in the town:

fr.L: Elle a envoyé ses servantes ; \q elle appelle des points les plus hauts de la ville :
fr.B: Elle a envoyé ses servantes porter l’invitation ; \q elle appelle depuis les hauteurs de la ville :
fr.R: Elle a envoyé ses servantes pour inviter les gens. \q Elle appelle depuis les endroits les plus hauts de la ville :

sw.L: Amewatuma wasichana wake; \q anaita kutoka mahali palipo juu kabisa mjini:
sw.B: Amewatuma wasichana wake na mwaliko; \q anaita kutoka mahali palipoinuka mjini:
sw.R: Amewatuma wajakazi wake wawaalike watu. \q Anaita kutoka mahali palipo juu kabisa mjini:

es.L: Ha enviado a sus muchachas; \q clama desde los lugares más altos de la ciudad:
es.B: Ha enviado a sus muchachas con la invitación; \q llama desde las alturas de la ciudad:
es.R: Ha mandado a sus sirvientas a invitar a la gente. \q Grita desde los lugares más altos de la ciudad:

decisions.choice: her young women: servants who carry the invitation
decisions.reason: A host sent servants to call the guests (Matthew 22:3).

source.text: מִי־פֶ֭תִי יָסֻ֣ר הֵ֑נָּה חֲסַר־לֵ֝֗ב אָ֣מְרָה לּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Who [is] simple, let him turn in here; [one] lacking heart, she says to him:

en.L: "Whoever [is] simple, let {{gender:them|him}} turn in here!" \q To one lacking heart she says,
en.B: "Whoever is naive, come in here!" \q To anyone who lacks sense she says,
en.R: "If you do not know much about life, come in here!" \q To people who do not have good sense she says,

fr.L: « Qui [est] simple, qu’il entre ici ! » \q À celui qui manque de cœur elle dit :
fr.B: « Vous qui êtes naïfs, entrez ici ! » \q À ceux qui manquent de bon sens elle dit :
fr.R: « Vous qui vous laissez tromper, entrez ici ! » \q À ceux qui n’ont pas de bon sens elle dit :

sw.L: "Yeyote [aliye] mjinga, na aingie hapa!" \q Kwa yule aliyepungukiwa na moyo husema,
sw.B: "Yeyote aliye mjinga, na aingie hapa!" \q Kwa yeyote asiye na akili husema,
sw.R: "Kama hujui mengi kuhusu maisha, ingia hapa!" \q Kwa watu wasio na busara husema,

es.L: «¡Quien [sea] simple, que se desvíe hacia acá!». \q Al falto de corazón le dice:
es.B: «¡Quien sea ingenuo, que entre aquí!». \q A todo el que no tiene sentido común le dice:
es.R: «Si no sabes mucho de la vida, ¡entra aquí!». \q A los que no tienen buen juicio les dice:

decisions.choice: whoever is simple, turn in here: repeated by Folly in 9:16
decisions.reason: Folly uses Wisdom's very words in verse 16. The simple must choose between two invitations that sound alike.

source.text: לְ֭כוּ לַחֲמ֣וּ בְֽלַחֲמִ֑י וּ֝שְׁת֗וּ בְּיַ֣יִן מָסָֽכְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: Come, eat of my bread, and drink of [the] wine I have mixed.

en.L: "Come, eat of my bread, \q and drink of [the] wine I have mixed.
en.B: "Come, have some of my food \q and taste the wine I have blended.
en.R: "Come and eat my food. \q Drink the wine I have made.

fr.L: « Venez, mangez de mon pain, \q et buvez du vin que j’ai mêlé.
fr.B: « Venez manger de mon pain \q et goûter le vin que j’ai préparé.
fr.R: « Venez manger ma nourriture. \q Buvez le vin que j’ai préparé.

sw.L: "Njooni, mle mkate wangu, \q na mnywe divai niliyoichanganya.
sw.B: "Njooni, mle chakula changu \q na kuonja divai niliyoichanganya.
sw.R: "Njooni mle chakula changu. \q Mnywe divai niliyoitengeneza.

es.L: «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, {{plural_you:coman|comed}} de mi pan, \q y {{plural_you:beban|bebed}} del vino [que] he mezclado.
es.B: «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, {{plural_you:coman|comed}} de mi comida \q y {{plural_you:prueben|probad}} el vino que he preparado.
es.R: «{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} y {{plural_you:coman|comed}} de mi comida. \q {{plural_you:Beban|Bebed}} el vino que he hecho.

decisions.choice: eat ... drink: Wisdom's teaching as food
decisions.reason: The meal stands for the teaching Wisdom gives (Isaiah 55:1–3). Jesus too spoke of himself as bread (John 6:35).

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}
decisions.reason: Wisdom invites her guests with plural commands in the Hebrew, so the Spanish forms take the ustedes/vosotros setting.

source.text: עִזְב֣וּ פְתָאיִ֣ם וִֽחְי֑וּ וְ֝אִשְׁר֗וּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ בִּינָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Abandon simpleness and live, and walk straight in [the] way of understanding.

en.L: Leave [your] simpleness and live, \q and walk straight in [the] way of understanding.
en.B: Leave your naive ways behind and live; \q walk straight down the road of understanding.
en.R: Stop being foolish, and you will live. \q Learn to understand.

fr.L: Quittez la simplicité et vivez, \q et marchez droit dans le chemin de l’intelligence.
fr.B: Laissez derrière vous la naïveté, et vivez ; \q avancez droit sur la route de l’intelligence.
fr.R: Arrêtez de vous laisser tromper, et vous vivrez. \q Apprenez à comprendre.

sw.L: Acheni ujinga [wenu] mkaishi, \q na mwende moja kwa moja katika njia ya ufahamu.
sw.B: Acheni njia zenu za ujinga mpate kuishi; \q nendeni moja kwa moja katika njia ya ufahamu.
sw.R: Acheni upumbavu, nanyi mtaishi. \q Jifunzeni kuelewa.

es.L: {{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} la simpleza y {{plural_you:vivan|vivid}}, \q y {{plural_you:avancen|avanzad}} por [el] camino del entendimiento.
es.B: {{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} atrás {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} ingenuidades y {{plural_you:vivan|vivid}}; \q {{plural_you:vayan|id}} derecho por el camino del entendimiento.
es.R: {{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} de ser necios, y {{plural_you:vivirán|viviréis}}. \q {{plural_you:Aprendan|Aprended}} a entender.

decisions.choice: simpleness: the ways of the simple, or the simple people themselves
decisions.reason: The word (petayim) is the plural used for "simple ones". It may mean "leave the simple", their company, or "leave simpleness".

decisions.choice: walk straight: the verb of 4:14
decisions.reason: The verb (ashar) shares its root with "how blessed".

source.text: יֹ֤סֵ֨ר׀לֵ֗ץ לֹקֵ֣חַֽ ל֣וֹ קָל֑וֹן וּמוֹכִ֖יחַ לְרָשָׁ֣ע מוּמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: [One] correcting a mocker receives for himself dishonor, and [one] reproving a wicked [person], his blemish.

en.L: Whoever corrects a mocker gets dishonor for {{gender:themselves|himself}}, \q and whoever reproves a wicked [person gets] {{gender:their|his}} [own] blemish.
en.B: Correct a mocker and you will be insulted; \q rebuke the wicked and you will get hurt.
en.R: If you correct people who make fun of others, they will insult you. \q If you correct evil people, they will hurt you.

fr.L: Qui corrige un moqueur s’attire le déshonneur, \q et qui reprend un méchant [s’attire] une flétrissure.
fr.B: Corrige un moqueur, et tu te feras insulter ; \q reprends un méchant, et tu seras blessé.
fr.R: Si tu corriges des moqueurs, ils t’insulteront. \q Si tu corriges des méchants, ils te feront du mal.

sw.L: Anayemwonya mwenye dharau hujipatia aibu, \q na anayemkaripia mwovu [hujipatia] jeraha lake.
sw.B: Mwonye mwenye dharau nawe utatukanwa; \q mkaripie mwovu nawe utaumizwa.
sw.R: Ukiwaonya watu wanaowadharau wengine, watakutukana. \q Ukiwaonya watu waovu, watakuumiza.

es.L: El que corrige al burlón recibe deshonra para sí, \q y el que reprende al malvado, su [propia] mancha.
es.B: Corrige al burlón y te insultará; \q reprende al malvado y saldrás herido.
es.R: Si corriges a los que se burlan de los demás, te insultarán. \q Si corriges a la gente mala, te harán daño.

decisions.choice: verses 7–12: Wisdom's sayings about who can be taught
decisions.reason: The section is a set of sayings set between the two invitations. Verse 11 ("by me") shows Wisdom is still speaking.

decisions.choice: his blemish: abuse, a hurt
decisions.reason: The word (mum) is a blemish or injury. The one who rebukes the wicked comes away hurt or insulted.

source.text: אַל־תּ֣וֹכַח לֵ֭ץ פֶּן־יִשְׂנָאֶ֑ךָּ הוֹכַ֥ח לְ֝חָכָ֗ם וְיֶאֱהָבֶֽךָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not reprove a mocker, lest he hate you; reprove a wise [person], and he will love you.

en.L: Do not reprove a mocker, lest {{gender:they|he}} hate you; \q reprove a wise [person], and {{gender:they|he}} will love you.
en.B: Do not rebuke a mocker, or you will be hated; \q rebuke the wise, and you will be loved.
en.R: Do not correct people who make fun of others, or they will hate you. \q Correct wise people, and they will love you.

fr.L: Ne reprends pas un moqueur, de peur qu’il ne te haïsse ; \q reprends un sage, et il t’aimera.
fr.B: Ne reprends pas un moqueur, sinon il te haïra ; \q reprends le sage, et il t’aimera.
fr.R: Ne corrige pas les moqueurs, sinon ils te détesteront. \q Corrige les sages, et ils t’aimeront.

sw.L: Usimkaripie mwenye dharau, asije akakuchukia; \q mkaripie mwenye hekima, naye atakupenda.
sw.B: Usimkaripie mwenye dharau, la sivyo atakuchukia; \q mkaripie mwenye hekima, naye atakupenda.
sw.R: Usiwaonye watu wanaowadharau wengine, la sivyo watakuchukia. \q Waonye watu wenye hekima, nao watakupenda.

es.L: No reprendas al burlón, no sea que te aborrezca; \q reprende al sabio, y te amará.
es.B: No reprendas al burlón, o te odiará; \q reprende al sabio, y te amará.
es.R: No corrijas a los que se burlan de los demás, o te odiarán. \q Corrige a los sabios, y te amarán.

decisions.choice: a mocker: one who scorns correction
decisions.reason: The mocker (lets) of 1:22: he cannot be taught because he will not be corrected (13:1; 15:12).

source.text: תֵּ֣ן לְ֭חָכָם וְיֶחְכַּם־ע֑וֹד הוֹדַ֥ע לְ֝צַדִּ֗יק וְי֣וֹסֶף לֶֽקַח׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Give to a wise [person], and he will become wiser still; teach a righteous [person], and he will increase learning.

en.L: Give to a wise [person], and {{gender:they|he}} will be wiser still; \q teach a righteous [person], and {{gender:they|he}} will increase in learning.
en.B: Give advice to the wise and they will grow wiser still; \q teach the righteous and they will add to what they know.
en.R: Teach wise people, and they will become even wiser. \q Teach good people, and they will learn more.

fr.L: Donne au sage, et il sera plus sage encore ; \q enseigne le juste, et il augmentera son savoir.
fr.B: Conseille le sage, et il deviendra encore plus sage ; \q instruis le juste, et il ajoutera à ce qu’il sait.
fr.R: Enseigne les sages, et ils deviendront encore plus sages. \q Enseigne les gens de bien, et ils apprendront davantage.

sw.L: Mpe mwenye hekima, naye atazidi kuwa na hekima; \q mfundishe mwenye haki, naye ataongeza elimu.
sw.B: Mpe shauri mwenye hekima naye atazidi kuwa na hekima; \q mfundishe mwenye haki naye ataongeza yale anayoyajua.
sw.R: Wafundishe watu wenye hekima, nao watazidi kuwa na hekima. \q Wafundishe watu wema, nao watajifunza zaidi.

es.L: Da al sabio, y será más sabio todavía; \q enseña al justo, y aumentará su saber.
es.B: Aconseja al sabio y se hará todavía más sabio; \q enseña al justo y añadirá a lo que sabe.
es.R: Enseña a los sabios, y serán todavía más sabios. \q Enseña a la gente buena, y aprenderá más.

decisions.choice: increase in learning: as in 1:5
decisions.reason: The book's opening promise (1:5) applies to those who are already wise.

source.text: תְּחִלַּ֣ת חָ֭כְמָה יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת קְדֹשִׁ֣ים בִּינָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] beginning of wisdom [is the] fear of YHWH, and [the] knowledge of [the] Holy One [is] understanding.

en.L: [The] beginning of wisdom [is the] fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and [the] knowledge of [the] Holy One [is] understanding.
en.B: Wisdom starts with the fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and to know the Holy One is understanding.
en.R: Becoming wise begins with honoring {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with awe. \q Knowing the holy God is what it means to understand.

fr.L: Le commencement de la sagesse [est] la crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q et la connaissance du Saint [est] l’intelligence.
fr.B: La sagesse commence par la crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q et connaître le Saint, c’est l’intelligence.
fr.R: Pour devenir sage, il faut d’abord honorer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avec respect. \q Connaître le Dieu saint, voilà ce que veut dire comprendre.

sw.L: Mwanzo wa hekima [ni] kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na kumjua Mtakatifu [ni] ufahamu.
sw.B: Hekima huanza kwa kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na kumjua Mtakatifu ndio ufahamu.
sw.R: Kuwa na hekima huanza kwa kumheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa hofu takatifu. \q Kumjua Mungu aliye mtakatifu ndiyo maana ya kuelewa.

es.L: [El] principio de la sabiduría [es el] temor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q y [el] conocimiento del Santo [es] entendimiento.
es.B: La sabiduría comienza con el temor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q y conocer al Santo es entendimiento.
es.R: Ser sabio empieza por honrar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con reverencia. \q Conocer al Dios santo es lo que significa entender.

decisions.choice: the beginning of wisdom is the fear of the LORD: as in 1:7
decisions.reason: Chapters 1–9 begin and end with this saying. Here the word for beginning (tehillah) means only the starting point.

decisions.choice: the Holy One: a plural of majesty
decisions.reason: The word (qedoshim) is plural, but like the word for God (elohim) it names the one holy God (30:3; Hosea 11:12).

source.text: כִּי־בִ֭י יִרְבּ֣וּ יָמֶ֑יךָ וְיוֹסִ֥יפוּ לְּ֝ךָ֗ שְׁנ֣וֹת חַיִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For by me your days will increase, and they will add to you years of life.

en.L: For by me your days will be many, \q and years of life will be added to you.
en.B: For through me your days will be many, \q and the years of your life will grow.
en.R: If you follow me, you will live a long life.

fr.L: Car par moi tes jours se multiplieront, \q et des années de vie te seront ajoutées.
fr.B: Car grâce à moi, tes jours seront nombreux, \q et les années de ta vie augmenteront.
fr.R: Si tu me suis, tu vivras longtemps.

sw.L: Kwa maana kwa mimi siku zako zitakuwa nyingi, \q na miaka ya uzima itaongezwa kwako.
sw.B: Kwa maana kupitia kwangu siku zako zitakuwa nyingi, \q na miaka ya maisha yako itaongezeka.

es.L: Porque por mí se multiplicarán tus días, \q y años de vida te serán añadidos.
es.B: Porque por medio de mí tus días serán muchos, \q y los años de tu vida aumentarán.
es.R: Si me sigues, tendrás una vida larga.

decisions.choice: by me: Wisdom speaks
decisions.reason: The "me" shows that verses 7–12 are part of Wisdom's speech. The promise is that of 3:2 and 4:10.

records.literal_gloss: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself; and [if] you mock, you alone will bear [it].

en.L: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself; \q and [if] you mock, you alone will bear [it]."
en.B: If you are wise, your wisdom will benefit you; \q if you mock, the cost is yours alone."
en.R: If you are wise, you are the one who will gain. \q If you make fun of wisdom, you are the one who will suffer."

fr.L: Si tu es sage, tu es sage pour toi-même ; \q et [si] tu te moques, toi seul [le] porteras. »
fr.B: Si tu es sage, ta sagesse te profitera ; \q si tu te moques, toi seul en paieras le prix. »
fr.R: Si tu es sage, c’est toi qui y gagneras. \q Si tu te moques de la sagesse, c’est toi qui en souffriras. »

sw.L: Ukiwa na hekima, una hekima kwa ajili yako mwenyewe; \q na ukidharau, wewe peke yako utabeba [matokeo]."
sw.B: Ukiwa na hekima, hekima yako itakufaidia wewe; \q ukidharau, gharama ni yako peke yako."
sw.R: Ukiwa na hekima, wewe ndiye utakayefaidika. \q Ukiidharau hekima, wewe ndiye utakayeteseka."

es.L: Si eres sabio, para ti eres sabio; \q y [si] te burlas, tú solo [lo] cargarás».
es.B: Si eres sabio, tu sabiduría te beneficiará; \q si te burlas, solo tú pagarás el precio».
es.R: Si eres sabio, tú eres el que gana. \q Si te burlas de la sabiduría, tú eres el que sufrirá».

decisions.choice: for yourself ... you alone: each one bears the result
decisions.reason: Wisdom's call is personal: the gain and the loss fall on the one who chooses.

decisions.choice: the verse ends here, as the Hebrew text has it
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation adds several lines after this verse. They are not in the Hebrew text.

source.text: אֵ֣שֶׁת כְּ֭סִילוּת הֹֽמִיָּ֑ה פְּ֝תַיּ֗וּת וּבַל־יָ֥דְעָה מָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: A woman of folly [is] loud; [she is] simpleness and does not know anything.

en.L: The woman Folly [is] loud; \q [she is] simpleness, and she does not know anything.
en.B: The woman Folly makes a lot of noise; \q she is gullible and has no knowledge.
en.R: Folly is like a woman who talks too loudly. \q She is foolish and knows nothing.

fr.L: La femme Folie [est] bruyante ; \q [elle est] simplicité, et elle ne sait rien.
fr.B: La femme Folie fait beaucoup de bruit ; \q elle est naïve et n’a aucune connaissance.
fr.R: La folie est comme une femme qui parle trop fort. \q Elle se laisse tromper et ne sait rien.

sw.L: Mwanamke Upumbavu [ni] mwenye kelele; \q [yeye ni] ujinga, wala hajui kitu chochote.
sw.B: Mwanamke Upumbavu hupiga kelele nyingi; \q ni mjinga wala hana maarifa.
sw.R: Upumbavu ni kama mwanamke anayeongea kwa sauti kubwa mno. \q Ni mpumbavu, wala hajui kitu.

es.L: La mujer Necedad [es] alborotadora; \q [es] simpleza, y no sabe nada.
es.B: La mujer Necedad hace mucho ruido; \q es crédula y no tiene conocimiento.
es.R: La necedad es como una mujer que habla demasiado fuerte. \q Es tonta y no sabe nada.

decisions.choice: the woman Folly: folly pictured as a woman
decisions.reason: As Wisdom is a woman with a house and a feast, so Folly is pictured as her rival. She is loud like the woman of 7:11.

decisions.choice: simpleness: the folly of the simple
decisions.reason: She is not only foolish herself; she is what the simple are.

decisions.choice: "la femme Folie" (Literal, Balanced), "elle" throughout 9:13–18
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pictures folly as a woman, set against Wisdom. French "la folie" is feminine, so the picture holds with "elle"; "Folie" here is the folly of the insensé (kesil), not madness, which the context makes plain.

decisions.choice: "Mwanamke Upumbavu" (the woman Folly), with a capital for the name, at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: Folly is set against Wisdom as a woman of her own; "mwanamke mpumbavu" would describe some foolish woman rather than name Folly herself. Readable says "Upumbavu ni kama mwanamke", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: la mujer Necedad
decisions.reason: Folly is pictured as a woman set against Wisdom. "Necedad" is feminine in Spanish and belongs with "necio", the word for the fool throughout Proverbs, so the picture and the link both stay.

source.text: וְֽ֭יָשְׁבָה לְפֶ֣תַח בֵּיתָ֑הּ עַל־כִּ֝סֵּ֗א מְרֹ֣מֵי קָֽרֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: And she sits at [the] door of her house, on a seat [at the] heights of [the] town,

en.L: And she sits at [the] door of her house, \q on a seat [at the] heights of [the] town,
en.B: She takes her seat in her doorway, \q on a chair up on the town's heights,
en.R: She sits in her doorway \q or on a chair in the highest place in town,

fr.L: Et elle est assise à la porte de sa maison, \q sur un siège [sur] les hauteurs de la ville,
fr.B: Elle s’assied sur le seuil de sa maison, \q sur un siège sur les hauteurs de la ville,
fr.R: Elle s’assied à sa porte \q ou sur une chaise à l’endroit le plus haut de la ville,

sw.L: Naye huketi mlangoni mwa nyumba yake, \q juu ya kiti [mahali] palipoinuka mjini,
sw.B: Huketi mlangoni pa nyumba yake, \q juu ya kiti mahali palipoinuka mjini,
sw.R: Huketi mlangoni pake \q au juu ya kiti mahali palipo juu kabisa mjini,

es.L: Y se sienta a [la] puerta de su casa, \q en una silla [en las] alturas de [la] ciudad,
es.B: Se sienta a la entrada de su casa, \q en una silla en lo alto de la ciudad,
es.R: Se sienta a la puerta de su casa \q o en una silla en el lugar más alto de la ciudad,

decisions.choice: the heights of the town: where Wisdom called (9:3)
decisions.reason: Folly copies Wisdom's place and words, but she sits and does not prepare anything.

records.literal_gloss: to call to those passing [on the] road, those going straight [on] their paths:

en.L: to call to those who pass by [on the] road, \q who are going straight [on] their paths:
en.B: calling to those who pass by, \q who are going straight along on their way:
en.R: calling to people who walk by, \q who are minding their own business:

fr.L: pour appeler ceux qui passent [sur] la route, \q qui vont droit [sur] leurs sentiers :
fr.B: pour appeler ceux qui passent, \q qui vont droit leur chemin :
fr.R: pour appeler les gens qui passent \q et qui s’occupent de leurs propres affaires :

sw.L: ili kuwaita wapitao [njiani], \q waendao moja kwa moja katika mapito yao:
sw.B: akiwaita wanaopita, \q wanaoendelea moja kwa moja na safari yao:
sw.R: akiwaita watu wanaopita, \q wanaoshughulika na mambo yao wenyewe:

es.L: para llamar a los que pasan [por el] camino, \q que van derecho [por] sus sendas:
es.B: llamando a los que pasan, \q que van derecho por su camino:
es.R: llamando a la gente que pasa, \q que va a lo suyo:

decisions.choice: going straight: people not looking for her
decisions.reason: Her targets are people on their way somewhere else. She draws them off their straight path.

source.text: מִי־פֶ֭תִי יָסֻ֣ר הֵ֑נָּה וַחֲסַר־לֵ֝֗ב וְאָ֣מְרָה לּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Who [is] simple, let him turn in here; and [one] lacking heart, she says to him:

en.L: "Whoever [is] simple, let {{gender:them|him}} turn in here!" \q And to one lacking heart she says,
en.B: "Whoever is naive, come in here!" \q And to anyone who lacks sense she says,
en.R: "If you do not know much about life, come in here!" \q To people who do not have good sense she says,

fr.L: « Qui [est] simple, qu’il entre ici ! » \q Et à celui qui manque de cœur elle dit :
fr.B: « Vous qui êtes naïfs, entrez ici ! » \q Et à ceux qui manquent de bon sens elle dit :
fr.R: « Vous qui vous laissez tromper, entrez ici ! » \q À ceux qui n’ont pas de bon sens elle dit :

sw.L: "Yeyote [aliye] mjinga, na aingie hapa!" \q Na kwa yule aliyepungukiwa na moyo husema,
sw.B: "Yeyote aliye mjinga, na aingie hapa!" \q Na kwa yeyote asiye na akili husema,
sw.R: "Kama hujui mengi kuhusu maisha, ingia hapa!" \q Kwa watu wasio na busara husema,

es.L: «¡Quien [sea] simple, que se desvíe hacia acá!». \q Y al falto de corazón le dice:
es.B: «¡Quien sea ingenuo, que entre aquí!». \q Y a todo el que no tiene sentido común le dice:
es.R: «Si no sabes mucho de la vida, ¡entra aquí!». \q A los que no tienen buen juicio les dice:

decisions.choice: the same words as Wisdom's (9:4)
decisions.reason: Folly's call is word for word the same as Wisdom's. The difference is in what each offers.

records.literal_gloss: Stolen waters are sweet, and bread of secrecy is pleasant.

en.L: "Stolen waters are sweet, \q and bread [eaten] in secret is pleasant."
en.B: "Water that is stolen tastes sweet, \q and food eaten where no one sees is a delight."
en.R: "Water you steal tastes sweeter. \q Food you eat in secret tastes better."

fr.L: « Les eaux volées sont douces, \q et le pain [mangé] en secret est agréable. »
fr.B: « L’eau volée a un goût sucré, \q et le pain qu’on mange en cachette est délicieux. »
fr.R: « L’eau qu’on vole a meilleur goût. \q La nourriture qu’on mange en cachette est meilleure. »

sw.L: "Maji yaliyoibwa ni matamu, \q na mkate [uliolibwa] kwa siri unapendeza."
sw.B: "Maji yaliyoibwa yana ladha tamu, \q na chakula kinacholiwa mahali pasipoonekana ni furaha."
sw.R: "Maji unayoiba yana ladha tamu zaidi. \q Chakula unachokula kwa siri kina ladha nzuri zaidi."

es.L: «Las aguas robadas son dulces, \q y el pan [comido] a escondidas es sabroso».
es.B: «El agua robada sabe dulce, \q y la comida que se come donde nadie ve es una delicia».
es.R: «El agua que robas sabe más dulce. \q La comida que comes a escondidas sabe mejor».

decisions.choice: stolen waters: forbidden love
decisions.reason: Water stands for married love in 5:15–18. Folly offers what belongs to someone else, and its sweetness comes from its being forbidden.

decisions.choice: bread: Folly has no feast of her own
decisions.reason: Wisdom prepared meat and wine (9:2); Folly offers only stolen water and bread.

source.text: וְֽלֹא־יָ֭דַע כִּֽי־רְפָאִ֣ים שָׁ֑ם בְּעִמְקֵ֖י שְׁא֣וֹל קְרֻאֶֽיהָ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And he does not know that [the] shades [are] there; in [the] depths of Sheol [are] her invited ones.

en.L: But {{gender:they do|he does}} not know that [the] shades [are] there, \q [that] her guests [are] in [the] depths of Sheol.
en.B: But those who turn in have no idea that the dead are in that house, \q that her guests lie deep in Sheol.
en.R: But people who go into her house do not know that it is full of dead people. \q Everyone she invites ends up in the grave.

fr.L: Mais il ne sait pas que les ombres [sont] là, \q [que] ses invités [sont] dans les profondeurs du Shéol.
fr.B: Mais ceux qui entrent ne savent pas que les morts sont dans cette maison, \q que ses invités gisent au fond du séjour des morts.
fr.R: Mais ceux qui entrent dans sa maison ne savent pas qu’elle est pleine de morts. \q Tous ceux qu’elle invite finissent au séjour des morts.

sw.L: Lakini hajui kwamba vivuli [viko] huko, \q [kwamba] wageni wake [wako] katika vilindi vya Kuzimu.
sw.B: Lakini wanaoingia hawajui kwamba wafu wamo nyumbani mle, \q kwamba wageni wake wamelala ndani kabisa ya Kuzimu.
sw.R: Lakini watu wanaoingia nyumbani kwake hawajui kwamba imejaa wafu. \q Kila anayemwalika huishia Kuzimu.

es.L: Pero no sabe que allí [están las] sombras, \q [que] sus invitados [están] en [las] profundidades del Seol.
es.B: Pero los que entran no tienen idea de que los muertos están en esa casa, \q de que sus invitados yacen en lo profundo del lugar de los muertos.
es.R: Pero los que entran en su casa no saben que está llena de muertos. \q Todos los que ella invita acaban en el lugar de los muertos.

decisions.choice: the shades: the dead
decisions.reason: The word (rephaim) of 2:18.

decisions.choice: the chapter ends here, as the Hebrew text has it
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation adds lines after this verse urging the reader to flee and drink from his own well. They are not in the Hebrew text.

decisions.choice: they
decisions.reason: Balanced uses "they" for the one who turns in, whom verse 16 does not limit to men.
